summary.core_decision: Official FY2025 actuals and corporate-action/share-basis adjustments are publication-ready for all 12 modeled names' broader-business valuation. 2026Q1 remains monitoring-only; Atlas-specific supplier/order/ASP/utilization/revenue/margin proof remains absent and Atlas credit stays zero.

claims.claim: Huawei stated that Atlas 950 hardware was publicly displayed for the first time at WAIC 2026.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: officially stated by Huawei
claims.evidence_gap: No independent event archive or acceptance record.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei stated that it publicly displayed Atlas 950 hardware for the first time at WAIC 2026.

claims.claim: The WAIC display was Huawei's first supernode.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 / prior Atlas 900 A3
claims.evidence_status: contradicted by predecessor SuperPoD disclosures
claims.evidence_gap: Huawei had already disclosed Atlas 900 A3/384-card SuperPoDs and deployments.
claims.adopted_wording: This was the first public physical display of Atlas 950, not Huawei's first SuperPoD/supernode.

claims.claim: Atlas 950 made its first global debut at MWC 2026.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: officially stated by Huawei
claims.evidence_gap: A product debut does not itself prove the physical configuration shown or commercial shipment.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei described MWC 2026 as Atlas 950's first global debut; the later WAIC statement specifically concerns first public hardware display.

claims.claim: The physical Atlas 950 system shown at WAIC had 1,024 cards.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: official vendor disclosure
claims.evidence_gap: No cabinet count, site, customer, acceptance, sustained utilization or independent benchmark.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei publicly displayed a 1,024-card Atlas 950 system.

claims.claim: Atlas 950 supports a maximum design configuration of 8,192 Ascend 950DT cards.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 / Ascend 950DT
claims.evidence_status: official vendor roadmap
claims.evidence_gap: No physical 8,192-card build, delivery, acceptance or utilization proof.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei's roadmap sets an up-to-8,192-card design ceiling; the physically shown system had 1,024 cards.

claims.claim: Huawei delivered or mass-produced an 8,192-card Atlas 950 system.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: not found in corpus
claims.evidence_gap: The corpus proves only a 1,024-card display and an 8,192-card roadmap ceiling.
claims.adopted_wording: No evidence in the checked corpus establishes an 8,192-card physical delivery or mass production.

claims.claim: The WAIC system has a 256 TB global unified memory-addressing space.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: official vendor disclosure
claims.evidence_gap: Memory hierarchy is not disclosed; CPU, pooled or storage-class memory inclusion is unknown.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei states a 256 TB global unified address space; it must not be relabeled as HBM capacity.

claims.claim: The 256 TB figure is Ascend 950DT HBM capacity.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 / Ascend 950DT
claims.evidence_status: not supported and numerically unreconciled
claims.evidence_gap: The 2025 roadmap states 144 GB per 950DT, while 256 TB/1,024 implies 256 GB per card; hierarchy is undisclosed.
claims.adopted_wording: Treat 256 TB as a system-level unified address space, not disclosed HBM capacity.

claims.claim: Ascend 950DT is planned with 144 GB HiZQ 2.0 memory, 4 TB/s memory bandwidth and 2 TB/s interconnect bandwidth.
claims.customer_or_platform: Ascend 950DT
claims.evidence_status: official vendor roadmap
claims.evidence_gap: No manufacturer, yield, capacity, cost or shipping configuration; WAIC system does not explicitly name 950DT.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei's September 2025 roadmap specifies these planned 950DT parameters; they are not independent production evidence.

claims.claim: Ascend 950DT is commercially available in 2026Q4.
claims.customer_or_platform: Ascend 950DT
claims.evidence_status: planned, not realized at cutoff
claims.evidence_gap: Cutoff precedes 2026Q4; no shipment, acceptance or customer deployment proof.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei planned 950DT availability for 2026Q4; availability had not been evidenced by the 2026-07-18 cutoff.

claims.claim: The 1,024-card WAIC system definitively used the disclosed 950DT production configuration.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 / Ascend 950DT
claims.evidence_status: not explicitly disclosed
claims.evidence_gap: The WAIC release does not explicitly name 950DT or silicon stepping.
claims.adopted_wording: The product family is linked to 950DT by Huawei's roadmap, but the displayed system's exact silicon configuration is not disclosed.

claims.claim: Atlas 950 commercial availability is planned for 2026Q4.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: official roadmap only
claims.evidence_gap: No named customer, order, delivery, acceptance or revenue at cutoff.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei planned Atlas 950 commercial availability for 2026Q4; the July display did not prove commercial acceptance.

claims.claim: More than 750 384-card Ascend SuperPoDs had been commercially deployed across more than 20 industries.
claims.customer_or_platform: Ascend 384-card predecessor generation
claims.evidence_status: official vendor statement
claims.evidence_gap: Not Atlas 950 deliveries and not proof of any upstream supplier order.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei states more than 750 predecessor 384-card SuperPoDs were deployed; keep this separate from Atlas 950 shipments.

claims.claim: Atlas 900 A3 had more than 300 units deployed for more than 20 customers.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 900 A3 / CloudMatrix384
claims.evidence_status: official vendor statement
claims.evidence_gap: Not Atlas 950 delivery and not upstream supplier proof.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei's predecessor Atlas 900 A3 deployment claim is demand context only and must not be counted as Atlas 950 orders.

claims.claim: The 500,000-plus-chip SuperCluster is one physical Atlas 950 SuperPoD.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 SuperCluster
claims.evidence_status: contradicted by official architecture boundary
claims.evidence_gap: SuperCluster is a separate 64-SuperPoD scale-out roadmap.
claims.adopted_wording: One Atlas 950 SuperPoD has an 8,192-card design ceiling; the 500,000-plus-chip figure refers to a separate 64-SuperPoD SuperCluster roadmap.

claims.claim: Huawei's Atlas 950 peak figures prove superiority over NVIDIA NVL144/NVL576.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 vs NVIDIA roadmap systems
claims.evidence_status: not independently normalized
claims.evidence_gap: Precision, sparsity, workload, software maturity, availability and system boundaries are not held constant.
claims.adopted_wording: Describe the comparison as Huawei's vendor roadmap comparison, not an independent benchmark conclusion.

claims.claim: NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 official page lists 72 GPUs, 36 Grace CPUs, 20 TB GPU memory and 130 TB/s NVLink bandwidth.
claims.customer_or_platform: GB300 NVL72
claims.evidence_status: official vendor specification
claims.evidence_gap: Vendor specs are not a normalized Atlas benchmark.
claims.adopted_wording: Use NVIDIA's official GB300 NVL72 specifications as peer context only.

claims.claim: AMD Helios is a 72-MI455X reference design with volume deployments expected in 2H26.
claims.customer_or_platform: Helios / MI455X
claims.evidence_status: official vendor specification and estimate
claims.evidence_gap: Reference design is not a product for sale; estimates may change.
claims.adopted_wording: AMD describes Helios as a reference design and expects volume deployments in 2H26; do not present the timing as realized.

claims.claim: Cross-vendor PFLOPS and memory figures are directly comparable.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 / GB300 / Helios
claims.evidence_status: not supportable without normalization
claims.evidence_gap: Precision, sparsity, workload, software and system boundaries differ.
claims.adopted_wording: Use official specifications as architecture context; do not rank performance without a normalized independent workload benchmark.

claims.claim: Current CR3/CR5 is established for all eight AIDC chain blocks.
claims.customer_or_platform: AIDC supply chain
claims.original_url: not found after the primary-source probes catalogued in the source file
claims.evidence_status: not found
claims.evidence_gap: No consistently scoped primary source with denominator, period and methodology.
claims.adopted_wording: CR3/CR5 is not disclosed for the checked blocks and must remain unavailable.

claims.claim: Huawei disclosed the Atlas 950 external supplier BOM.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 suppliers
claims.evidence_status: not found
claims.evidence_gap: No official supplier list, qualification, allocation, order, ASP, capacity, utilization or margin.
claims.adopted_wording: Huawei's public Atlas disclosures do not identify an external supplier BOM.

claims.claim: Huawei disclosed the HiZQ 2.0 HBM wafer, base-die, packaging and volume-production suppliers.
claims.customer_or_platform: Ascend 950DT / HiZQ 2.0
claims.evidence_status: not found
claims.evidence_gap: Manufacturer, qualification, yield, capacity, cost and shipment are absent.
claims.adopted_wording: No checked primary source identifies HiZQ 2.0 manufacturing or packaging suppliers.

claims.claim: Atlas 950 system price, power, optical-module count, cooling BOM, PCB area and connector count are disclosed.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: not found
claims.evidence_gap: All listed unit-economics fields are missing.
claims.adopted_wording: Do not build a top-down Atlas BOM revenue model from the disclosed card/cabinet counts.

claims.claim: UBoE necessarily increases the number of external Ethernet switches and optical modules.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 UBoE / RoCE
claims.evidence_status: official source points in the opposite direction
claims.evidence_gap: Huawei claims fewer switches/modules than RoCE, but no topology or counts are disclosed.
claims.adopted_wording: Do not infer optical unit counts from RoCE clusters; Huawei claims UBoE can require fewer switches and modules, but the claim is unverified and unquantified.

claims.claim: iFlytek and Huawei are jointly developing on the Ascend 950 platform.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei Ascend 950
claims.evidence_status: officially disclosed downstream cooperation
claims.evidence_gap: No compute procurement, system order, cost saving, benchmark, revenue or margin bridge.
claims.adopted_wording: iFlytek is an explicit downstream Ascend 950 co-development validator, not an Atlas upstream supplier.

claims.claim: iFlytek will launch a flagship model on Ascend 950 at the October 2026 developer festival.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei Ascend 950
claims.evidence_status: issuer plan, not realized
claims.evidence_gap: Launch timing, performance, cost and monetization not observed at cutoff.
claims.adopted_wording: iFlytek plans an October 2026 flagship-model launch on Ascend 950; treat as a future validation event.

claims.claim: Talkweb is a Huawei Ascend/Kunpeng ecosystem partner and Huawei represented 41.51% of 2025 sales.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei / Ascend ecosystem
claims.evidence_status: official filing; financial statements have a standard unqualified opinion; one director abstained on the annual report
claims.valuation_eligibility: watchlist only; zero Street valuation weight
claims.evidence_gap: No Atlas qualification/order, business-level allocation, product ASP, utilization, Atlas revenue or product-margin bridge; no fresh 2026E/2027E original broker report. One director abstained and could not ensure the report's accuracy/completeness.
claims.adopted_wording: Talkweb's official 2025 filing supports a broad Huawei/Ascend/Kunpeng relationship and 41.51% Huawei sales concentration; it does not establish Atlas 950 supply, and Talkweb remains watchlist-only with zero Street valuation weight.

claims.claim: Shenling's historical customer list includes Huawei; 2025 data-service revenue grew 51.42% and new orders grew about 72%.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei / H company / data-service customers
claims.evidence_status: official full annual report
claims.valuation_eligibility: eligible for broader AIDC issuer valuation only
claims.evidence_gap: Huawei/H-company customer allocation, Atlas qualification/order, ASP, utilization, Atlas revenue and product-level margin are not disclosed.
claims.adopted_wording: Shenling's official 2025 filing names Huawei in its historical customer list and reports 51.42% data-service revenue growth and about 72% new-order growth; these support broader AIDC valuation, while Atlas-specific revenue/EPS credit remains zero.

claims.claim: The Shenling investor Q&A confirms H company is Huawei and confirms an Atlas order.
claims.customer_or_platform: H company / Huawei / Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: not confirmed in answer
claims.evidence_gap: The Q&A does not name H company or Atlas. The later official 2025 annual report separately names Huawei in a historical customer list and describes H-company business generally, but still gives no customer allocation or Atlas order.
claims.adopted_wording: Do not state that the Q&A identifies H company or confirms an Atlas order; the official annual report supports only a general/historical Huawei relationship and broader data-service growth.

claims.claim: Envicool has a disclosed stable relationship with Huawei in communication-cabinet thermal control.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei communication equipment
claims.evidence_status: officially disclosed at a different application boundary
claims.evidence_gap: No Atlas/liquid-cooling qualification, order, allocation, ASP or segment margin.
claims.adopted_wording: Envicool names Huawei as a communication-cabinet thermal-control customer; do not extend that relationship to Atlas 950.

claims.claim: Envicool is a confirmed Atlas 950 liquid-cooling supplier.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: not found
claims.evidence_gap: No Atlas platform qualification, order, revenue split, ASP, utilization or margin.
claims.adopted_wording: Envicool is a broader thermal/AIDC participant; Atlas 950 supplier status is unverified.

claims.claim: HGTECH is an exclusive Atlas 950 optical supplier.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei Atlas 950
claims.evidence_status: not found
claims.evidence_gap: Official filing supports optical products and segment delivery only; no Huawei/Atlas customer, exclusivity, share or order.
claims.adopted_wording: HGTECH has broader AI interconnect delivery; Atlas 950 exclusivity or supply share is unverified.

claims.claim: Aerospace Electric confirmed it supplies Ascend 950 backplane and liquid-cooling components.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei Ascend 950
claims.evidence_status: not confirmed in company answer
claims.evidence_gap: Answer lists relevant products and downstream customers generally but does not confirm Ascend 950 or revenue.
claims.adopted_wording: Aerospace Electric discloses relevant connector and liquid-cooling products; the Ascend 950 relationship remains unconfirmed.

claims.claim: Qiangyi supplies probe cards for Ascend 950 and named HBM makers.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei Ascend 950 / HBM
claims.evidence_status: company declined to confirm
claims.evidence_gap: Response directs investors to public disclosures and names no customer, certification, order or volume.
claims.adopted_wording: Qiangyi's probe-card capability is public, but Ascend 950/HBM customer relationships are not confirmed.

claims.claim: Sichuan Changhong conducts the claimed Ascend AI-server ODM business.
claims.customer_or_platform: Ascend 950 / AI-server ODM
claims.evidence_status: explicitly denied
claims.evidence_gap: Company says it does not conduct the described business; Huakun is not consolidated.
claims.adopted_wording: Exclude Sichuan Changhong from the claimed Ascend AI-server ODM beneficiary mapping.

claims.claim: Digital China's 2025 AI-related revenue was CNY33.03bn, up 47.7%.
claims.customer_or_platform: broad AI infrastructure / Kunpeng-Ascend ecosystem
claims.evidence_status: official issuer record
claims.evidence_gap: Metric includes broad distribution; no Atlas product, customer, gross profit or order split.
claims.adopted_wording: Use the disclosed AI-related revenue only as a broad business metric, not Atlas 950 revenue.

claims.claim: Kehua Data has an Atlas 950 order because it serves domestic Ascend innovation infrastructure.
claims.customer_or_platform: Ascend innovation center / Atlas 950
claims.temporal_status: historical capability plus inferred platform claim
claims.evidence_status: Atlas inference not supported
claims.evidence_gap: No Atlas customer, order, ASP, revenue allocation or product margin.
claims.adopted_wording: Kehua Data has broader AIDC power/liquid-cooling capability; Atlas 950 exposure is not confirmed.

claims.claim: Huawei Digital Power's 3.2 MW PowerPOD proves Atlas 950 deployment or external supplier attachment.
claims.customer_or_platform: Atlas 950 power infrastructure
claims.evidence_status: not Atlas-specific
claims.evidence_gap: No Atlas deployment, supplier share, order or economics.
claims.adopted_wording: PowerPOD is generic AIDC capability context, not evidence of Atlas 950 deployment or external supplier orders.

claims.claim: Samsung, Micron or SK hynix supplies Huawei HiZQ 2.0 because each has HBM4 capability.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei HiZQ 2.0
claims.evidence_status: not found
claims.evidence_gap: Official pages establish HBM4 capability/readiness, not Huawei qualification or allocation.
claims.adopted_wording: HBM4 capability at global suppliers does not identify the HiZQ 2.0 supply chain.

claims.claim: Luxshare ICT's AI-rack interconnect portfolio proves Atlas 950 qualification.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei Atlas 950
claims.source_type: official product page plus unsupported customer inference
claims.evidence_status: product capability only
claims.evidence_gap: No Huawei customer, Atlas qualification, order, ASP or revenue.
claims.adopted_wording: Luxshare's AI-rack portfolio is capability evidence only; Atlas 950 qualification is not disclosed.

claims.claim: Shennan Circuits and Victory Giant's AI PCB exposure proves Atlas 950 board allocation.
claims.customer_or_platform: Huawei Atlas 950
claims.source_type: official filings plus unsupported platform inference
claims.evidence_status: general AI exposure only
claims.evidence_gap: No Atlas board, material grade, layer stack, qualification, volume, ASP or margin.
claims.adopted_wording: These filings support general AI/data-center PCB capability, not Atlas 950 allocation.

claims.claim: Policy support for compute interconnection and energy efficiency constitutes an Atlas 950 order.
claims.customer_or_platform: National compute infrastructure
claims.evidence_status: policy direction only
claims.evidence_gap: No procurement, vendor selection, project value or deployment schedule.
claims.adopted_wording: Policy supports the demand environment but does not prove Atlas procurement or supplier revenue.

claims.claim: FY2025 actuals and corporate-action/share-basis adjustments for all 12 modeled issuers are reconciled to official annual-report originals; 2026Q1 observations are monitoring-only.
claims.customer_or_platform: Broader-business valuation baseline / official FY2025 filings
claims.source_type: official annual reports plus deterministic reconciliation
claims.temporal_status: historical FY2025 actuals and current forward-share basis
claims.evidence_status: 12/12 official originals reconciled; valuation reproducibility checks PASS
claims.evidence_gap: Official 2026Q1 issuer originals remain unarchived and are excluded from target arithmetic; no Atlas order/ASP/utilization/revenue-margin bridge is provided by the annual reports.
claims.adopted_wording: Use official FY2025 actuals and reconciled current-share bases for the 12-name broader-business valuation; keep 2026Q1 monitoring-only and Atlas-specific earnings credit at zero.

claims.claim: Nine issuers disclosed official 2026H1 preliminary earnings through 2026-07-17.
claims.customer_or_platform: 2026H1 earnings previews
claims.evidence_status: official but unaudited
claims.evidence_gap: Attachment PDFs are not archived locally; results may differ from final reports.
claims.adopted_wording: Use disclosed H1 ranges as unaudited preliminary results, not audited final figures or Atlas attribution.

claims.claim: 2026-07-17 close prices for 22 issuers matched between Tencent and Sina.
claims.customer_or_platform: secondary market
claims.original_url: https://qt.gtimg.cn/; Sina endpoint not disclosed in corpus
claims.evidence_status: two-source match
claims.evidence_gap: Raw provider payloads not archived; market data are time-bound.
claims.adopted_wording: Use 2026-07-17 close prices with the stated cutoff and provider provenance.

claims.claim: Northbound holdings are a 2026-07-17 daily observation.
claims.customer_or_platform: HKEX Northbound
claims.evidence_status: date misclassification
claims.evidence_gap: Latest official observation is quarter-end 2026-06-30; denominator can lag corporate actions.
claims.adopted_wording: Northbound holdings are the official 2026-06-30 quarter-end observation, not a 2026-07-17 daily position.
